system_schema:
Schema for Restaurants
Intent: ReserveRestaurant
required slots: restaurant name,location,time
optional slots: number of seats,date
Intent: FindRestaurants
required slots: category,location
optional slots: price range,has vegetarian options,has seating outdoors
dialog:
User: Hello, I was wondering if you could help me find a place to eat?
System: Yes, I can certainly do that. Is there a city you would like to focus on? And what type of cuisine?
User: I would like to eat at a barbecue restaurant. Preferably somewhere in Emeryville.
System: ApiCall(method='FindRestaurants', parameters={'category': 'American', 'location': 'Emeryville'})
Search Results
[{'address': '5800 Hollis Street', 'category': 'American', 'has_seating_outdoors': 'True', 'has_vegetarian_options': 'True', 'location': 'Emeryville', 'phone_number': '510-595-1000', 'price_range': 'moderate', 'rating': '4.30', 'restaurant_name': 'The Bureau 510'}]
End Search Results
System: I have found 1 restaurant that matches your inquiry. The Bureau 510 is a barbecue restaurant located in Emeryville.
User: Yes, that works for me. Can you help me book a table there? It will be a reservation for one person on March 10th at 11:45 am.
System: Please confirm the reservation details: A table for 1 at The Bureau 510 in Emeryville for March 10th at 11:45 am.
User: Yes, that is correct.
System: ApiCall(method='ReserveRestaurant', parameters={'date': '2019-03-10', 'location': 'Emeryville', 'number_of_seats': '1', 'restaurant_name': 'The Bureau 510', 'time': '11:45'})
Search Results
[{'address': '5800 Hollis Street', 'category': 'American', 'date': '2019-03-10', 'has_seating_outdoors': 'True', 'has_vegetarian_options': 'True', 'location': 'Emeryville', 'number_of_seats': '1', 'phone_number': '510-595-1000', 'price_range': 'moderate', 'rating': '4.30', 'restaurant_name': 'The Bureau 510', 'time': '12:00'}]
End Search Results
System: Sorry, it seems as though the 11:45 am time slot is unavailable. Would you be fine with a reservation for 1 at The Bureau 510 on March 10th at 12 pm instead?
User: Yes, I can do that.
System: ApiCall(method='ReserveRestaurant', parameters={'date': '2019-03-10', 'location': 'Emeryville', 'number_of_seats': '1', 'restaurant_name': 'The Bureau 510', 'time': '12:00'})

User: Thank you for your help!
System: Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Last User Utterance:No, that will be all. Thank you again.
Last System Utterance: Have a good day, goodbye!
